title: session statement
description: The statement text agent-session-v1 of agent_core.passkey.certificate (04-crypto.md section 4.9): five lines joined by a line feed without a trailing one - label, origin, session P-256 public key (65-byte point, b64u), hub value (32 bytes, b64u), expiry YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. The certificate carries its UTF-8 bytes as b64u.
